messages:
Nora: Quick heads-up: doing initial bring-up for orchid-v2 (fp16 -> q5) on staging. Found deterministic detok spacing problem for CJK + Arabic spans. Short thread with examples and logs below.
Taro: paste sample?
Nora: example:
```
INPUT: 日語とالعربية are mixed here.
EXPECTED (fp16 reference): 日語と العربية are mixed here.  -- space between CJK and RTL word
FP16 OUTPUT: 日語と العربية are mixed here.
Q5 OUTPUT: 日語と العربية are mixed here.  <-- punctuation/space glued to CJK; Arabic rendered but no separator
```
Lina: ugh. tokenization changed or detok heuristics flipped? Any token id diffs?
Nora: token-id diffs look benign for this sample. Batch compare on mixed-orient smoke (2k samples) shows zh->ar BLEU -0.9; punctuation-spacing failures up 18% on q5 vs fp16.
Ben: Likely profile resolution. detok loads profiles from /etc/redwood/locale_profiles.json. If q5 runtime chdir differs, relative paths break. Logs show: 
```
2026-03-22T20:03:11Z orchid-init: tokenizer v3 loaded
2026-03-22T20:03:11Z quant-runtime: q5 kernels ready
2026-03-22T20:03:11Z profile-loader: open("./profiles/locale_profiles.json") -> ENOENT
2026-03-22T20:03:11Z detok: profile missing, using generic-join fallback
```
Priya: fp16 sets absolute path; quant bootstrap changed CWD for mmap reasons. Absolute-path fix safest.
Taro: Add metric: "CJK-RTL separator rate" to shadow-eval. Fail bring-up if drop >5% vs baseline.
Lina: I'll PR profile-loader -> resolve absolute path + unit test. @Ben add detok-sanity to onboarding CI.
Ben: infra-bot, queue detok sanity for orchid-q5 canary.
infra-bot: Queued job: ci/detok_sanity/orchid-q5-2026-03-22 #998. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/998 :rocket:
Nora: Created ticket ML-3510 with failing sample ids and diffs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-3510
Priya: I'll also track the quant-init CWD change separately. For now pause wide rollout until detok smoke passes.
Ben: Will run a shadow canary forcing absolute profile path to confirm.
Nora: Thanks all — will post CI results here when job finishes. :thumbsup:
